title: The residue sweep writes a page's words in one call, and a grouped call whose outcome is unknown is never sent again
steps: S1: Run a sweep round (sweepRound) with two pairs of one page in one call, one of them refused by name.
S2: Run a sweep round whose grouped call writes 'Menu item' -> 'Menu item for customer' and 'Price' -> 'Cost', then loses its answer (thrown, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, 502, undone write).
S3: Run a sweep round whose grouped call is refused before any write without naming a pair.
expect: S1: the record is saved once; the refused pair is reported as its own refusal and the rest is sent again.
S2: exactly one call is sent; the page reads 'Menu item for customer · Cost'; no pair reads NOT_FOUND.
S3: the call is split and each pair sent again.
evidence: Dev 27/10/2026: one WordPress ja-diner demo check wrote 362 post updates over 65 posts; the four colour copies of Home took 58 content.update rows each. 28/10/2026: a first grouped version resent a call whose answer was lost and replaced 'Menu item' twice
fence: Grouping and resend guard of the dsh residue sweep

cmd: --test-name-pattern=save its record once|never sent again|split and sent again
tests: a page's pairs in one call save its record once; a refused pair is set aside, reported as its own, the rest sent again
a grouped call whose outcome is unknown is never sent again: each pair answers that outcome, the page as written
a refusal that proves nothing was written is split and sent again; a grouped write with a lost receipt is sent once
